title: Provide direct line-range reads without manual span hashes
wanted_capability: Code-mode agents should be able to read a bounded file line range with `{ file, startLine, endLine }` directly, with the server deriving the current content hash/span internally, so simple source inspection does not require a separate code.items call or placeholder span retries.
missing_primitive: code.readLines({ file, startLine, endLine }) or equivalent line-range read helper
fallback_used: The probe tried a placeholder span hash, hit a stale-span error, then made extra calls to derive a real content hash before reading the bounded range.
notes: Generic finding from a private Java probe. This is an ergonomics gap that creates avoidable cells and stale-span mistakes during bounded inspection.
